If something moves zigzag, it moves forward, while at the same time going left and right a little.
The drunk headed zigzag across the park.
zillion: A zillion refers to an extremely large number.
zimbabwean: A Zimbabwean is a citizen of Zimbabwe.
Something or someone that is Zimbabwean comes from Zimbabwe.
zinc: Zinc is a type of metal, (symbol Zn) with an atomic number of 30 on the periodic table.
If you zinc something, you cover it with zinc.
zing: A zing is a short high-pitched humming sound, it is similar to those made by a bullet or vibrating string.
A zing is a witty insult or derogatory remark.
If something zings, it moves very quickly.
If you zing a person, you attack or criticize them with a remark.
zinger: A zinger is a surprising or humorous remark or insult.
zionist: A Zionist is a person who supports Zionism.
zip: A zip is a sound made by a small object.
A zip is a short form of zipper.
Is the zip on your coat working.
If something zips somewhere, it move there quickly.
The birds zip from tree to tree.
If you zip something up, you close its zipper.
Zip up your coat before going outside.
zipper: A zipper is a device used to join two pieces of cloth for a short amount of time. It usually consists of 2 strips of metal on both pieces of cloth that are then joined together.
zirconium: Zirconium is a metallic (meaning made of metal) element with an atomic number of 40 and symbol Zr.
zit: Zit is a small red and painful spot on the skin.
Zit is a person that annoys and bothers other people.
zodiac: The 12 signs, or houses, of the zodiac. Each sign is named after one of the constellations in the zodiac.
A circle decorated with the signs of the zodiac.
My friend has a tattoo of a zodiac.
zombie: Someone who looks very tired and messy may be called a zombie. It is equivalent to saying someone "looks like a corpse".
zonal: If something is zonal, it is related to or arranged in zones.
zone: A zone is an area that is known for a particular use.
You are in a no-smoking zone.
If you zone something, you divide into it; you give it a particular use.
If you zone a property, you determine what the property will be used for.
zoo: A zoo is a park that people go to where live animals can be seen.
There are lions at our local zoo.
zookeeper: A zookeeper is someone who works at a zoo and takes care of the animals.
We saw the zookeeper feeding the tiger in the zoo.
zoological: Zoological specimens, medicine, studies, etc. relate to the study of animals.
He works at the city's zoological research centre.
A zoological park, society, garden, etc. is one related to a zoo.
The children visited the zoological gardens.
zoologist: A zoologist is a person who studies zoology.
zoology: Zoology is the science of learning about animals.
He likes animals, so he wants to study zoology in university.
zoom: To change the focus of a zoom lens
zygote: A zygote is a fertilized egg cell.
zzz: Zzz is a way to write a snoring sound, in comics and picture books, showing that somebody is asleep.
à la: à la refers to being according to, or in the style of something.
I hadn't cooked tomatoes à la crème in a long time.
à la carte: If you order à la carte in restaurants, you order individual items from a menu instead of ordering a set combination of Dishes.
The restaurant had a huge à la carte menu.
æ: Æ is a ligature of AE.
Do you know about Julius Cæsar?
éclair: An éclair is a chocolate treat with white filling
éclairs: The plural form of éclair; more than one (kind of) éclair.
éclat: An éclat is a brilliant display or successful effect.
éclats: The plural form of éclat; more than one (kind of) éclat.
œ: Œ is a ligature of OE.
Amœba is a well known genus of unicellular organism, a protist.
